From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Pilot evidence & decision map — Redwood x BeaconHealth (post-call recap)

Hi Sophie / Jared —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the internal path at BeaconHealth.

Recap (short):
- Pilot scope: 3 clinics, aggregate PHI redaction workflow + note summarization.
- Success criteria: 99% uptime during business hours; token cost target <= $0.0025/response; no PII leakage in retained artifacts.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff targeted for mid-November if procurement/legal clearances complete.

Primary asks we agreed to surface to your teams:
1) Economic buyer / final signer: please confirm who will sign/approve pilot (finance or line-of-business?).
2) Security evidence list (we can host or share via your secure link):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — summary + controls matrix
   - External pen-test executive summary (no raw logs)
   - Audit log retention and access model (how long logs are retained, where)
   - Data retention / deletion policy for pilot data
   - Encryption at-rest/in-transit and KMS details
3) Procurement logistics: typical PO / SOW cadence and any mandatory contract language.

What I can provide by EOD Monday (Oct 8):
- SOC 2 executive summary (redacted)
- Pen-test executive summary
- Draft evidence delivery checklist

Internal owners I’ll loop in: Priyom (security/evidence packaging) and Neha (customer success onboarding).

Next steps: can we confirm a short sync with Procurement + Legal next week (30 minutes)? I propose Tue 10/9 or Wed 10/10 — whatever works for your team.

Attachments: evidence-delivery-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Subject: Re: Pilot evidence & decision map — Redwood x BeaconHealth (post-call recap)

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Economic buyer: Jared (cc'd) will be final approver for contract value up to $150k. For anything above that we escalate to our VP Finance.
- Legal contact: looping in Paula for redlines/questions on the SOW.
- Procurement cadence: we typically require SOC 2 Type II summary + pen-test exec summary up front; our procurement team will then request a completed vendor security questionnaire.

Can you attach the SOC 2 summary and pen-test exec summary when available? Procurement has asked specifically about:
- Where audit logs are stored and how long they are retained (we have a 7-year data retention policy for audit records in our environment)
- Any subprocessors and their locations (US/EU)

Tue 10/9 at 16:00 ET works for a quick procurement/legal sync — invite sent. If you want the session to be prep-heavy, please include the checklist and the SOC2+pen-test stubs before the meeting.

Thanks,
Sophie Grant
Director, Digital Transformation | BeaconHealth
sophie.grant@beaconhealth.com
